newsitem.title: USA: Comsat to divest Ascent stake, sees Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Comsat to divest Ascent stake, sees Q4 loss.

text.p: Comsat Corp said on Friday it expected to have a net operating loss in the fourth quarter, partly due to its 80 percent interest in Ascent Entertainment Group Inc, but it planned to divest this stake.
The company said Ascent's capital needs had put pressure on Comsat's balance sheet and were constraining its ability to expand the core international telecommunications and venture businesses.

Other factors which could hurt fourth quarter results include the operating performance of its business segments, unanticipated costs associated with the integration of Spectravision's and On Command Video Corp's businesses, and the timing and method of the proposed divestiture of interest in Ascent, Comsat said.

Ascent Entertainment recently agreed to acquire the assets of Spectravision Inc, under Spectravision's bankruptcy reorganization plan. Ascent said it would combine the assets of its 85 percent owned unit On Command Video Corp with SpectraVision's assets, to form a new company.

"As a result of the Spectravision transaction, the deconsolidation of On Command Corp for tax purposes and Ascent's anticipated operating results, Comsat now expects to report a net operating loss in the fourth quarter," said company president and chief executive officer Betty Alewine.
Comsat said Ascents revenues for the third quarter 1996 $33.9 million as compared with $37.5 million for the same quarter last year.

Comsat said it had engaged Morgan Stanley & Co Inc to act as an advisor for the Ascent divestiture. Ascent would be divested as a sale, a spin-off or via another type of transaction, the company said.
